name: V-92 Tine Hunter
description: The V-92 Tine Hunter was a starfighter used by various criminal factions during the Imperial Era such as the Pyke Syndicate, Crimson Dawn, and pirate groups. The starfighter featured a hull and cockpit similar to the Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter. At each of its wingtips, the V-92 had two KX9 laser cannons and was additionally equipped with a deflector shield generator and two engines.
